purpose: Verify hostel-specific Warden and Caretaker role binding is maintained and the change is recorded
preconditions: Super Admin logged in; Hostel H1 exists; user U1 exists
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns U1 as Warden of H1, then reassigns the Warden role of H1 to user U2
expected_result: Role binding is stored per hostel (H1), and each role change made by the Super Admin is recorded

purpose: Verify student can access hostel-specific data only for the hostel they are allocated to
preconditions: Student S1 allocated to hostel H1; hostel H2 has no association with S1
action_or_input: S1 requests hostel-specific data of H1, then of H2
expected_result: Access to H1 data is granted; access to H2 data is denied

purpose: Verify Super Admin has institution-level access across hostels without restricting configuration
preconditions: Super Admin logged in; hostels H1 and H2 exist; no HM configuration restricts Super Admin
action_or_input: Super Admin accesses data and functions of H1 and H2
expected_result: Access is permitted for both hostels

purpose: Verify time-bound role validity is enforced when start and end dates are configured
preconditions: Warden role for U1 in H1 configured with start date D1 and end date D2
action_or_input: U1 attempts Warden functions within D1–D2 and again after D2
expected_result: Access is permitted within the validity period and denied after the end date

purpose: Verify RBAC restricts users to data and functions permitted by role and hostel assignment
preconditions: Warden W1 assigned to H1 only; H2 exists
action_or_input: W1 attempts a permitted function on H1 and the same function on H2
expected_result: Function on H1 succeeds; function on H2 is denied

purpose: Verify newly assigned role holder can view pending HM records of the assigned hostel
preconditions: H1 has pending HM records; Caretaker C1 currently assigned to H1
action_or_input: Super Admin reassigns H1 Caretaker role to C2; C2 opens pending records for H1
expected_result: C2 can view the pending HM records for H1, subject to RBAC

purpose: Verify allotment decision is recorded and room assignment information is updated
preconditions: Student S1 awaiting allotment; room R1 in H1 has free capacity
action_or_input: Authorized user records allotment of S1 to R1
expected_result: Allotment decision is recorded and room assignment for S1/R1 is updated

purpose: Verify room assignment history is maintained
preconditions: S1 assigned to R1; R2 has free capacity
action_or_input: Authorized user changes S1 assignment from R1 to R2, then views assignment history
expected_result: History shows both the R1 assignment and the change to R2 with traceable details

purpose: Verify occupancy cannot exceed defined room capacity
preconditions: Room R1 capacity = 2 and currently has 2 occupants; student S3 unassigned
action_or_input: Attempt to assign S3 to R1
expected_result: Assignment is rejected; occupancy remains 2

purpose: Verify attendance records are retained and available for review
preconditions: Attendance recorded for H1 on date D1
action_or_input: Authorized user retrieves attendance records for D1 at a later time
expected_result: The attendance records for D1 are retained and retrievable

purpose: Verify leave history is retained
preconditions: Student S1 has submitted and had a leave request processed
action_or_input: Authorized user views leave history for S1
expected_result: The leave request and its status history are retained and displayed

purpose: Verify complaint captures category and description, with optional attachment
preconditions: Student S1 logged in; complaint form available
action_or_input: Submit a complaint with category and description and no attachment; submit another with an attachment (where the form provides the field)
expected_result: Both complaints are saved with category and description; the attachment is captured when provided

purpose: Verify HM covers hostel-related complaints only
preconditions: Student S1 logged in
action_or_input: Submit a hostel-related complaint, then attempt to submit a non-hostel complaint
expected_result: Hostel-related complaint is accepted; non-hostel complaint is not handled by HM

purpose: Verify guest-room booking history is maintained
preconditions: Guest-room booking request B1 submitted and status updated
action_or_input: Authorized user views guest-room booking history
expected_result: B1 and its status changes are retained and viewable

purpose: Verify guest-room management is limited to booking-request handling and status tracking
preconditions: Booking request B1 exists
action_or_input: Review available guest-room functions in HM
expected_result: Booking-request handling and status tracking are available; check-in, check-out, inspection, charge collection and settlement are not provided

purpose: Verify applicable extended-stay charge amount is recorded
preconditions: Extended-stay request exists; charges are applicable and represented in HM
action_or_input: Event supplies extended-stay charge amount for the request
expected_result: The charge/fee amount is recorded against the extended-stay request

purpose: Verify payment deadline and compliance status are recorded for extended-stay decisions
preconditions: Extended-stay request exists; deadline/compliance information is maintained in HM
action_or_input: Event supplies payment deadline and compliance status
expected_result: Deadline and payment/deadline compliance status are recorded and available for the extended-stay decision

purpose: Verify application window is enforced only when configured
preconditions: Extended-stay application window configured and enforced; date outside window
action_or_input: Student submits extended-stay request outside the configured window
expected_result: Request is rejected per the configured window

purpose: Verify fine record requires reason, amount, date and affected student reference
preconditions: Authorized user on fine creation function
action_or_input: Submit fine with all four fields; then submit fines each omitting one of reason, amount, date, student reference
expected_result: Complete fine is saved; each incomplete fine is rejected with a validation error

purpose: Verify inventory and staff coordination records and accountability logs are maintained
preconditions: Caretaker C1 logged in for assigned hostel H1
action_or_input: Update a hostel inventory record and a staff coordination record
expected_result: Updates are saved and an accountability log entry is created for each

purpose: Verify Warden/Caretaker can publish notices only for assigned hostels
preconditions: Warden W1 assigned to H1 only
action_or_input: W1 publishes a notice for H1, then attempts to publish a notice for H2
expected_result: Notice for H1 is published; notice for H2 is denied

purpose: Verify notice history is maintained
preconditions: Notice N1 published in H1
action_or_input: Authorized user views notice history for H1
expected_result: N1 appears in the retained notice history

purpose: Verify notice board displays relevant notices to authorized users
preconditions: Notice N1 published for H1; S1 allocated to H1; unauthorized user U9
action_or_input: S1 opens the H1 notice board; U9 attempts to open it
expected_result: S1 sees N1; U9 is denied access

purpose: Verify predefined reports and operational summaries are produced from HM records
preconditions: HM records exist; authorized user logged in
action_or_input: Run a predefined HM report
expected_result: Report/operational summary is generated from HM records

purpose: Verify notification issued for a supported HM event
preconditions: Notification mechanism configured; S1 allocated to R1
action_or_input: Change S1 room allocation
expected_result: A notification/status update is issued to the relevant users via the Fusion notification infrastructure or configured mechanism

purpose: Verify Caretaker operations are supported within assigned hostel and shift context
preconditions: Caretaker C1 assigned to H1 with shift context configured
action_or_input: C1 performs a caretaker operation for H1, then for H2
expected_result: Operation on H1 is supported; operation on H2 is not
